entities.summary: Blake Aubry Swihart is an American professional baseball catcher and outfielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox and Arizona Diamondbacks. Listed at 6 feet 1 inch (1.85 m) and 205 pounds (93 kg), he throws right-handed and is a switch hitter. Blake Swihart was a athletes & competitors from Bedford (b. 1992-04-03, Bedford).
